title: (Re-)Linkage to care- How does HIV-PrEP improve linkage to care for Hepatitis
summary: We are investigating the extent to which the regular monitoring of patients with PrEP (a prophylactic medication against HIV) has an influence on the prevention, the detection and the treatment of hepatitis B, C and D.

interventions.name: Participants that take or have taken Tenofovirproxilfumarat/ emtricitabine 245mg/200mg daily or on demand (PrEP)

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Inclusion Criteria
1) PrEP use between 2016 and inclusion into study
2) informed consent
3) sufficient language skills to read and understand questionaire (provided in German, English and Arabic)
Exclusion criteria:
Exclusion Criteria
1) not able to understand informed consent or questionnaires
2) pregnancy
